objective: Test whether removing CURRENT.md as a mandatory pre-read for ordinary stateful/domain recovery reduces Ron↔GPT-5.6 Sol orchestration overhead without weakening exact-owner recovery, provenance, continuity, permission safety, or cross-domain continuation.

roles_before.artifact: BOOTSTRAP.md and skills/ron-work-protocol.md allow self-contained requests to answer directly.
Exact domain/project owners plus claim-specific live owners own current truth.
CURRENT.md provides a cross-domain/global continuation and architecture checkpoint.
Selected repo-local skills/*.md provide reusable domain procedures before exact owners.
Exact-owner write/read-back and cross-domain CURRENT.md update when materially changed.
PROTOCOL.md and integrations contracts gate live-source mutation.
Git history, architecture manifest and reusable candidate branch preserve rollback/provenance.

role_dispositions.destination: Self-contained/general requests still stop at BOOTSTRAP and answer directly.
Ordinary current-state recovery still requires domain routing, selected skill, exact owner and live owner when mutable.

CURRENT.md remains authoritative as a cross-domain/global checkpoint but is loaded only when the request materially depends on that checkpoint, unresolved system-wide architecture/maintenance state, or a checkpoint not discoverable from selected exact owners.
Mandatory selected-skill-before-owner behavior is unchanged in this experiment.
Continuity deltas still write to exact owners and CURRENT.md is updated only when cross-domain continuation materially changes.
No live mutation authority or permission gate changes.
Candidate starts exactly at recorded main SHA; Git history and manifest preserve rollback and comparison.

capability_probes.assertion: A single-domain current-state/continuation request still recovers the exact skill, owner and claim-relevant live owner without relying on memory.
A single-domain continuation whose checkpoint is fully owned by its exact owner must not load CURRENT.md merely because the request is personal/stateful.
A genuinely cross-domain/global continuation or architecture-status request still loads CURRENT.md and preserves its checkpoint role.
Historical evidence, current-owner provenance, rollback and exact main baseline remain recoverable; no state is deleted or re-owned.

tests.command: Run tests/current-routing-overhead-ab-v1-prompts.md in matched fresh GPT-5.6 Sol chats against frozen main control and this candidate; blind-score with tests/current-routing-overhead-ab-v1-key.md.
tests.expected: Candidate has zero hard fails, preserves cross-domain CURRENT recovery where required, preserves exact-owner/live-owner correctness, and reduces irrelevant CURRENT loading or time/tool/context cost on eligible single-domain stateful tasks.

tests.command: python tests/architecture_change_guard.py && python tests/architecture_change_guard_selftest.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard_selftest.py && python tests/capital_system_guard.py
